title: How Much a Week in China Actually Costs (From $300) | China Travel Expert
description:
A full week in China can cost less than you think. Budget travellers realistically spend about $30–70 a day — roughly $300–500 for the week including beds, food, transport and sights. A mid-range week (3-star hotels, high-speed rail, restaurant meals) runs closer to $560–1,050.

Why it stays cheap: hostel dorm beds are $5–11, street-food meals $1.50–3, a bowl of hand-pulled noodles under $2, and a metro ride under $1. A bullet train that would cost a fortune in Europe is often just $40–90, and many historic sites are free.

🧭 Expert Tip: Mid-range is the sweet spot — budget ~$100/day for comfortable 3-star hotels plus high-speed rail between cities.

在中国玩一周,最低300美元就够:青旅床位5-11美元、街边面不到2美元、地铁1美元以内、高铁常常只要40-90美元。
